messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: rstan 2.8.1 and 2.8.2 released
parts:
On Monday, November 23, 2015 at 4:19:01 PM UTC-5, Ben Goodrich wrote:
There were some bugs that were fixed, although a couple more were apparently introduced and already discovered:
  • Passing arguments through the ... of stan() will not work directly because they get passed to stanc() accidentally. This includes chain_id, init_r, test_grad, refresh, and enable_random_init. To work around this, you can first call stan_model() and then pass that to sampling() along with init_r, refresh, etc. Or you can install rstan from github
    devtools::install_github("stan-dev/rstan", ref = "v2.8.1-1", subdir = "rstan/rstan")
  • Calling expose_stan_functions() on a .stan file with print() statements in user-defined Stan functions will not work at the moment. You can comment out the print() statements or shortly call
    source("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stan-dev/rstan/develop/rstan/rstan/R/expose_stan_functions.R") # R >= 3.2.2 or
    devtools    ::source_url("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stan-dev/rstan/develop/rstan/rstan/R/expose_stan_functions.R")

These were fixed in RStan 2.8.2, which is available in binary form from CRAN mirrors now.

Ben
